description: This file defines a utility class ConnectionWatchdog that manages perceived connection health by periodically restarting the LinkManager and listening to engine time events to trigger reconnection attempts.

classes.name: ConnectionWatchdog
classes.description: A utility class that manages connection health by scheduling periodic reconnections and listening to engine time updates to trigger reconnect logic.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the connection watchdog by setting up engine time listener and triggering initial data arrival handling.

methods.name: onDataArrived
methods.description: Restarts the reconnect timer and triggers reconnection logic.
